sections.text: Every month, independent bookkeepers spend 20 plus hours deciphering messy bank feeds. Sending confidential statements to cloud AI leaks client data and risks hallucinated account codes. LedgerShield solves this: reconcile confidently, keep financial data local.
Let's load Northstar Electrical Services, with 57 realistic contractor transactions and an active Chart of Accounts. All transactions start unreviewed, with zero cloud exposure.
Now watch LedgerShield's two-stage engine in action. Deterministic rules resolve recurring suppliers instantly, while local open-weight AI classifies ambiguous expenses against our Chart of Accounts.
LedgerShield never silently auto-approves. Let's inspect Platt Electric Supply. In one click, we persist a custom vendor rule directly into local SQLite, automating all future statements.
For tricky marketplace charges without receipts, switch to the Client Inquiry Builder. It generates structured questions ready to copy straight into Slack or email.

Finally, export audit-compliant CSVs ready for QuickBooks or Xero, and inspect our benchmark showing an 82 percent accuracy rate at zero marginal token cost. LedgerShield: reconcile confidently, keep financial data local.
